data.one_liner: Client for connecting to PackageKit to manage Linux software packages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API over D-Bus to communicate with the PackageKit service. It can query the daemon, list packages, install, remove and get details about software on Linux systems.
use_when: You need to install, remove or query Linux packages from a Flutter/Dart app
You require direct D-Bus interaction with PackageKit without writing low‑level D-Bus code
avoid_when: Your app runs on non‑Linux platforms
You need a UI‑focused package manager or cross‑platform solution
strengths: Keeps up with latest dbus package
weaknesses: Linux‑only, no support for other OSes
Relies on the system's PackageKit daemon being present
data.setup_notes: Add packagekit to pubspec, ensure the PackageKit service is running on the target Linux system; no extra build steps required.

alternatives.name: dbus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides lower‑level D‑Bus access if you prefer to implement PackageKit calls yourself
